It retains all **100 measurements: five cases × 20 alternating-order pairs**, with complete byte assertions. No observations were trimmed.

The four smaller/blob cases were faster in all 20 pairs. The `multiple_text` case had median paired borrowed/original ratio **1.0664289** and was faster in only 10/20 pairs. Ordering matters: its medians were 1.2050854 with original-first and 0.9557795 with borrowed-first. The first side's result vector also remained live while the second side was timed. These observations do not establish an end-to-end parity or indexing improvement.

A separately prepared equal-lifetime candidate remains an untriggered, archived alternative. Its code and prospective measurements are not credited to this PR or the original study.

pi.github.com/users/jyqj/gists{/gist_id}","starred_url":"https://api.github.com/users/jyqj/starred{/owner}{/repo}","subscriptions_url":"https://api.github.com/users/jyqj/subscriptions","organizations_url":"https://api.github.com/users/jyqj/orgs","repos_url":"https://api.github.com/users/jyqj/repos","events_url":"https://api.github.com/users/jyqj/events{/privacy}","received_events_url":"https://api.github.com/users/jyqj/received_events","type":"User","user_view_type":"public","site_admin":false},"parents":[{"sha":"b02dcfbe034598923f15b9cfeecb3b12e8329357","url":"https://api.github.com/repos/jyqj/codecortex/commits/b02dcfbe034598923f15b9cfeecb3b12e8329357","html_url":"https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/commit/b02dcfbe034598923f15b9cfeecb3b12e8329357"}]}],"files":[{"sha":"89c434b3ed7eeea90600583e8837bf5a40d5117f","filename":".github/workflows/p8-oracle-serialization-equal-lifetime-cost.yml","status":"added","additions":253,"deletions":0,"changes":253,"blob_url":"https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/f6750cad0df45af4ec2dddc456e76cc188f3a35a/.github%2Fworkflows%2Fp8-oracle-serialization-equal-lifetime-cost.yml","raw_url":"https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/raw/f6750cad0df45af4ec2dddc456e76cc188f3a35a/.github%2Fworkflows%2Fp8-oracle-serialization-equal-lifetime-cost.yml","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/jyqj/codecortex/contents/.github%2Fworkflows%2Fp8-oracle-serialization-equal-lifetime-cost.yml?ref=f6750cad0df45af4ec2dddc456e76cc188f3a35a","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,253 @@
+name: P8 oracle equal-lifetime serialization cost observation
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+  pull_request:
+    types: [labeled]
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+defaults:
+  run:
+    shell: bash
+
+env:
+  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: never
+  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: '0'
+  CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: '2'
+  RUSTFLAGS: ''
+  CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS: ''
+  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
+  P8_COST_EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+  P8_COST_TEST: benchmark::oracle::projection_tests::borrowed_serialization_equal_lifetime_release_cost_probe
+
+jobs:
+  observe:
+    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.label.name == 'p8-oracle-equal-lifetime-cost-run'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 90
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
+          sparse-checkout: |
+            /*
+            !/artifacts/
+      - name: Prepare original output directory
+        run: |
+          mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/p8-oracle-equal-lifetime-cost"
+          printf 'P8_COST_OUTPUT=%s/p8-oracle-equal-lifetime-cost\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          printf 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR=%s/p8-oracle-equal-lifetime-cost-target\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.95.0
+      - name: Bind actual source, compiler and probe command
+        run: |
+          python3 -B - <<'PY'
+          import hashlib
+          import json
+          import os
+          from pathlib import Path
+          import subprocess
+          import sys
+          from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+          root = Path(os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE'])
+          out = Path(os.environ['P8_COST_OUTPUT'])
+          sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'scripts'))
+          from p7_build_identity import source_snapshot
+
+          source = source_snapshot(root)
+          assert source['source_commit'] == os.environ['P8_COST_EXPECTED_HEAD']
+          observers = {}
+          for path in ('scripts/p7_build_identity.py', '.github/workflows/p8-oracle-serialization-equal-lifetime-cost.yml'):
+              original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + path], cwd=root)
+              live = (root / path).read_bytes()
+              assert live == original, path
+              observers[path] = hashlib.sha256(live).hexdigest()
+          (out / 'source-before.json').write_text(json.dumps(source, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
+          (out / 'Cargo.lock').write_bytes((root / 'Cargo.lock').read_bytes())
+          compiler = {}
+          for name, command in [('rustc', ['rustc', '-vV']), ('cargo', ['cargo', '-Vv'])]:
+              value = subprocess.check_output(command, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
+              (out / (name + '-before.txt')).write_bytes(value)
+              compiler[name] = hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
+          argv = ['cargo', 'test', '--release', '--locked', '--message-format=json', '-p', 'cc-eval', '--lib',
+                  os.environ['P8_COST_TEST'], '--', '--exact', '--ignored', '--nocapture', '--test-threads=1']
+          receipt = {'schema': 'p8-oracle-serialization-equal-lifetime-cost-observation-v1',
+                     'created_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+                     'run_id': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'], 'run_attempt': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT'],
+                     'expected_source': os.environ['P8_COST_EXPECTED_HEAD'],
+                     'source_commit': source['source_commit'], 'source_tree': source['source_tree'],
+                     'Cargo_lock_sha256': hashlib.sha256((root / 'Cargo.lock').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+                     'observer_inputs': observers, 'toolchain_output_sha256': compiler, 'argv': argv,
+                     'environment': {key: os.environ.get(key) for key in
+                         ('CARGO_INCREMENTAL', 'CARGO_BUILD_JOBS', 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR', 'RUSTFLAGS',

+"""Finite controls for the actual inline JSON observer, never native execution."""
+import ast
+import copy
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import tempfile
+
+import yaml
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+WORKFLOW = ROOT / '.github/workflows/p8-oracle-serialization-equal-lifetime-cost.yml'
+document = yaml.safe_load(WORKFLOW.read_text())
+blocks = []
+for step in document['jobs']['observe']['steps']:
+    value = step.get('run', '')
+    if value.startswith("python3 -B - <<'PY'\n"):
+        body = value.split('\n', 1)[1].rsplit('\nPY', 1)[0]
+        ast.parse(body)
+        blocks.append(body)
+assert len(blocks) == 3
+assert 'runner.' not in json.dumps(document['env'])
+node = next(n for n in ast.parse(blocks[2]).body
+            if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == 'observe_cost_output')
+namespace = {'json': json, 'Path': Path, 're': re, 'hashlib': hashlib}
+exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[node], type_ignores=[]), str(WORKFLOW), 'exec'), namespace)
+results = []
+with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='oracle-cost-observer-controls-') as directory:
+    out, source, target = [Path(directory) / name for name in ('out', 'source', 'target')]
+    for path in (out, source, target):
+        path.mkdir()
+    executable = target / 'probe'
+    executable.write_bytes(b'Synthetic identity only; this file is never executed.\n')
+    artifact = {
+        'reason': 'compiler-artifact',
+        'target': {'name': 'cc_eval', 'kind': ['lib'], 'src_path': str(source / 'crates/cc-eval/src/lib.rs')},
+        'profile': {'test': True, 'opt_level': '3', 'debug_assertions': False},
+        'executable': str(executable), 'package_id': 'path+file://' + str(source) + '/crates/cc-eval#1.0.0',
+        'manifest_path': str(source / 'crates/cc-eval/Cargo.toml'), 'features': ['default'], 'fresh': False,
+    }
+    records = [dict(schema='p8-oracle-serialization-equal-lifetime-cost-v1', case=case, round=i, rows=256,
+                    first='original' if i % 2 == 0 else 'borrowed', original_ns='100', borrowed_ns='101',
+                    original_digest='a' * 64, borrowed_digest='a' * 64, reference_digest='a' * 64, canonical_bytes=1024,
+                    timing_threshold=None, original_row_projection_source_blob='4c7fdb879e039af164b3b10ea1491d538c69ac68',
+                    timing_scope='same SQLite SELECT traversal plus row serialization and output retention; verification, hash and output drop excluded',
+                    output_lifetime='one immutable shared reference; each side output verified, hashed and dropped before next side timing',
+                    order_limit='alternating order retained; allocator and cache history not reset or claimed eliminated',
+                    comparison_protocol='independent equal-lifetime observation; not a rerun or correction of the v1 retained-pair probe')
+               for case in ('multiple_text', 'short_fields', 'blob', 'empty_text', 'null') for i in range(20)]
+    for case in ('complete_prefix', 'compiler_warning_quotes_schema', 'zero_tests', 'missing_slot',
+                 'duplicate_slot', 'digest_change', 'wrong_producer', 'failed_process', 'wrong_default_feature',
+                 'wrong_reference', 'retained_pair_lifetime', 'timing_threshold', 'wrong_protocol'):
+        values, event = copy.deepcopy(records), copy.deepcopy(artifact)
+        if case == 'zero_tests': values = []
+        if case == 'missing_slot': values.pop()
+        if case == 'duplicate_slot': values[-1] = copy.deepcopy(values[0])
+        if case == 'digest_change': values[33]['borrowed_digest'] = 'b' * 64
+        if case == 'wrong_producer': event['manifest_path'] = str(source / 'wrong/Cargo.toml')
+        if case == 'wrong_default_feature': event['features'] = []
+        if case == 'wrong_reference': values[0]['reference_digest'] = 'b' * 64
+        if case == 'retained_pair_lifetime': values[0]['output_lifetime'] = 'both outputs retained'
+        if case == 'timing_threshold': values[0]['timing_threshold'] = 1.0
+        if case == 'wrong_protocol': values[0]['comparison_protocol'] = 'v1 rerun'
+        lines = [json.dumps(event), json.dumps({'reason': 'build-finished', 'success': True})]
+        if case == 'compiler_warning_quotes_schema':
+            lines.append(json.dumps({'reason': 'compiler-message', 'message': {
+                'message': 'quoted p8-oracle-serialization-equal-lifetime-cost-v1 in a compiler diagnostic'}}))
+        lines += [('test benchmark::oracle::projection_tests::borrowed_serialization_equal_lifetime_release_cost_probe ... '
+                   if i == 0 else '') + json.dumps(value) for i, value in enumerate(values)]
+        count = '0' if case == 'zero_tests' else '1'
+        lines.append('test result: ok. ' + count + ' passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 23 filtered out; finished in 0.01s')
+        (out / 'probe.stdout').write_text('\n'.join(lines) + '\n')
+        (out / 'execution.json').write_text(json.dumps({'exit_code': 1 if case == 'failed_process' else 0,
+                                                       'launch_error': None}))
+        try:
+            namespace['observe_cost_output'](out, source, target)
+            accepted, error = True, None
+        except Exception as exc:
+            accepted, error = False, type(exc).__name__
+        assert accepted == (case in ('complete_prefix', 'compiler_warning_quotes_schema')), case
+        results.append({'case': case, 'accepted': accepted, 'error_type': error, 'expected_result_observed': True})

+receipt = {'scope': 'Actual inline observer AST on synthetic Cargo/probe text. No Rust, Actions, native workload, or scale replay.',

+target.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')

             }
         }
     }
+
+    #[test]
+    #[ignore = "explicit finite release cost observation; no timing acceptance threshold"]
+    fn borrowed_serialization_equal_lifetime_release_cost_probe() {
+        use rusqlite::types::Value as SqlValue;
+        use std::time::Instant;
+
+        fn collect(
+            statement: &mut rusqlite::Statement<'_>,
+            projection: &mut RowProjection<'_>,
+            borrowed: bool,
+        ) -> (Vec<String>, u128) {
+            let started = Instant::now();
+            let mut rows = statement.query([]).unwrap();
+            let mut output = Vec::new();
+            while let Some(row) = rows.next().unwrap() {
+                output.push(if borrowed {
+                    projection.serialize_row(row).unwrap()
+                } else {
+                    original_serialize_row(projection, row).unwrap()
+                });
+            }
+            (output, started.elapsed().as_nanos())
+        }
+
+        // The output Vec never crosses this function boundary. Both sides
+        // retain only the same immutable reference while their timer runs.
+        fn observe_side(
+            statement: &mut rusqlite::Statement<'_>,
+            projection: &mut RowProjection<'_>,
+            borrowed: bool,
+            reference: &[String],
+            reference_digest: &str,
+        ) -> (u128, String, usize) {
+            let (output, elapsed_ns) = collect(statement, projection, borrowed);
+            assert_eq!(output.as_slice(), reference);
+            assert_eq!(output.len(), 256);
+            let canonical_bytes = output.iter().map(String::len).sum();
+            let digest = manifest::digest(&serde_json::to_vec(&output).unwrap());
+            assert_eq!(digest, reference_digest);
+            drop(output);
+            (elapsed_ns, digest, canonical_bytes)
+        }
+
+        let cases = [
+            (
+                "multiple_text",
+                vec![
+                    SqlValue::Text("é/中文\n\"\\".repeat(512)),
+                    SqlValue::Text("manifest-payload".repeat(256)),
+                    SqlValue::Text("qualified::name".repeat(128)),
+                    SqlValue::Text("path/to/source.rs".repeat(128)),
+                    SqlValue::Integer(17),
+                    SqlValue::Null,
+                ],
+            ),
+            (
+                "short_fields",
+                vec![
+                    SqlValue::Text("a".into()),
+                    SqlValue::Text("bc".into()),
+                    SqlValue::Integer(i64::MIN),
+                    SqlValue::Integer(i64::MAX),
+                    SqlValue::Real(-0.0),
+                    SqlValue::Real(1.25),
+                ],
+            ),
+            (
+                "blob",
+                vec![
+                    SqlValue::Blob([0, 255, 128, 1].repeat(1024)),
+                    SqlValue::Blob(Vec::new()),
+                    SqlValue::Text("blob-name".into()),
+                    SqlValue::Integer(4),
+                    SqlValue::Null,
+                    SqlValue::Real(0.0),
+                ],
+            ),
+            ("empty_text", vec![SqlValue::Text(String::new()); 6]),
+            ("null", vec![SqlValue::Null; 6]),
+        ];
+        let cols: Vec<String> = ["z", "a", "payload", "path", "ordinal", "empty"]
+            .into_iter()
+            .map(String::from)
+            .collect();
+        for (case, values) in cases {
+            let conn = Connection::open_in_memory().unwrap();
+            conn.execute_batch("CREATE TABLE sample(c0,c1,c2,c3,c4,c5)")
+                .unwrap();
+            for _ in 0..256 {
+                conn.execute(
+                    "INSERT INTO sample VALUES(?1,?2,?3,?4,?5,?6)",
+                    rusqlite::params_from_iter(&values),
+                )
+                .unwrap();
+            }
+            let mut statement = conn
+                .prepare("SELECT c0,c1,c2,c3,c4,c5 FROM sample ORDER BY rowid")
+                .unwrap();
+            let mut original = RowProjection::new(&cols);
+            let mut borrowed = RowProjection::new(&cols);
+            // Independent protocol: build one immutable complete reference
+            // outside all measured rounds. Preserve the original baseline's
+            // reusable Map and the same SQLite input/SELECT for both sides.
+            let (reference, _) = collect(&mut statement, &mut original, false);
+            assert_eq!(reference.len(), 256);
+            let reference_digest = manifest::digest(&serde_json::to_vec(&reference).unwrap());
+            let reference_bytes = reference.iter().map(String::len).sum::<usize>();
+            for is_borrowed in [false, true] {
+                let projection = if is_borrowed {
+                    &mut borrowed
+                } else {
+                    &mut original
+                };
+                let _ = observe_side(
+                    &mut statement,
+                    projection,
+                    is_borrowed,
+                    &reference,
+                    &reference_digest,
+                );
+            }
+            for round in 0..20 {
+                // Each completed side verifies full bytes, hashes and drops
+                // its output before the next side enters collect's timer.
+                let (original_result, borrowed_result) = if round % 2 == 0 {
+                    let original_result = observe_side(
+                        &mut statement,
+                        &mut original,
+                        false,
+                        &reference,
+                        &reference_digest,
+                    );
+                    let borrowed_result = observe_side(
+                        &mut statement,
+                        &mut borrowed,
+                        true,
+                        &reference,
+                        &reference_digest,
+                    );
+                    (original_result, borrowed_result)
+                } else {
+                    let borrowed_result = observe_side(
+                        &mut statement,
+                        &mut borrowed,
+                        true,
+                        &reference,
+                        &reference_digest,
+                    );
+                    let original_result = observe_side(
+                        &mut statement,
+                        &mut original,
+                        false,
+                        &reference,
+                        &reference_digest,
+                    );
+                    (original_result, borrowed_result)
+                };
+                let (original_ns, original_digest, original_bytes) = original_result;
+                let (borrowed_ns, borrowed_digest, borrowed_bytes) = borrowed_result;
+                assert_eq!(original_bytes, reference_bytes);
+                assert_eq!(borrowed_bytes, reference_bytes);
+                println!(
+                    "{}",
+                    json!({
+                        "schema": "p8-oracle-serialization-equal-lifetime-cost-v1",
+                        "case": case,
+                        "round": round,
+                        "first": if round % 2 == 0 { "original" } else { "borrowed" },

-0,0 +1,253 @@
+name: P8 oracle equal-lifetime serialization cost observation
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+  pull_request:
+    types: [labeled]
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+defaults:
+  run:
+    shell: bash
+
+env:
+  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: never
+  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: '0'
+  CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: '2'
+  RUSTFLAGS: ''
+  CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS: ''
+  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
+  P8_COST_EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+  P8_COST_TEST: benchmark::oracle::projection_tests::borrowed_serialization_equal_lifetime_release_cost_probe
+
+jobs:
+  observe:
+    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.label.name == 'p8-oracle-equal-lifetime-cost-run'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 90
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
+          sparse-checkout: |
+            /*
+            !/artifacts/
+      - name: Prepare original output directory
+        run: |
+          mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/p8-oracle-equal-lifetime-cost"
+          printf 'P8_COST_OUTPUT=%s/p8-oracle-equal-lifetime-cost\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          printf 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR=%s/p8-oracle-equal-lifetime-cost-target\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.95.0
+      - name: Bind actual source, compiler and probe command
+        run: |
+          python3 -B - <<'PY'
+          import hashlib
+          import json
+          import os
+          from pathlib import Path
+          import subprocess
+          import sys
+          from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+          root = Path(os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE'])
+          out = Path(os.environ['P8_COST_OUTPUT'])
+          sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'scripts'))
+          from p7_build_identity import source_snapshot
+
+          source = source_snapshot(root)
+          assert source['source_commit'] == os.environ['P8_COST_EXPECTED_HEAD']
+          observers = {}
+          for path in ('scripts/p7_build_identity.py', '.github/workflows/p8-oracle-serialization-equal-lifetime-cost.yml'):
+              original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + path], cwd=root)
+              live = (root / path).read_bytes()
+              assert live == original, path
+              observers[path] = hashlib.sha256(live).hexdigest()
+          (out / 'source-before.json').write_text(json.dumps(source, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
+          (out / 'Cargo.lock').write_bytes((root / 'Cargo.lock').read_bytes())
+          compiler = {}
+          for name, command in [('rustc', ['rustc', '-vV']), ('cargo', ['cargo', '-Vv'])]:
+              value = subprocess.check_output(command, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
+              (out / (name + '-before.txt')).write_bytes(value)
+              compiler[name] = hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
+          argv = ['cargo', 'test', '--release', '--locked', '--message-format=json', '-p', 'cc-eval', '--lib',
+                  os.environ['P8_COST_TEST'], '--', '--exact', '--ignored', '--nocapture', '--test-threads=1']
+          receipt = {'schema': 'p8-oracle-serialization-equal-lifetime-cost-observation-v1',
+                     'created_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+                     'run_id': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'], 'run_attempt': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT'],
+                     'expected_source': os.environ['P8_COST_EXPECTED_HEAD'],
+                     'source_commit': source['source_commit'], 'source_tree': source['source_tree'],
+                     'Cargo_lock_sha256': hashlib.sha256((root / 'Cargo.lock').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+                     'observer_inputs': observers, 'toolchain_output_sha256': compiler, 'argv': argv,
+                     'environment': {key: os.environ.get(key) for key in
+                         ('CARGO_INCREMENTAL', 'CARGO_BUILD_JOBS', 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR', 'RUSTFLAGS',
+                          'CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS', 'RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN', 'TMPDIR', 'TMP', 'TEMP')},
+                     'scope': 'Finite release serialization cost observation; not a scale sample or TODO acceptance gate.'}
+          (out / 'identity-before.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
+          PY
+      - name: Observe the independent equal-lifetime finite ignored probe and retain both streams
+        run: |
+          python3 -B - <<'PY'
+          import json
+          import os
+          from pathlib import Path
+          import subprocess
+          import sys
+          import time
+          from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+          out = Path(os.environ['P8_COST_OUTPUT'])
+          identity = json.loads((out / 'identity-before.json').read_text())
+          started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
+          begin = time.monotonic_ns()
+          code = None
+          error = None
+          try:
+              with (out / 'probe.stdout').open('wb') as stdout, (out / 'probe.stderr').open('wb') as stderr:
+                  code = subprocess.run(identity['argv'], cwd=os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE'],
+                                        stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, check=False).returncode
+          except BaseException as exc:
+              error = type(exc).__name__ + ': ' + str(exc)
+              raise
+          finally:
+              receipt = {'started_utc': started, 'finished_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+                         'wall_ns': time.monotonic_ns() - begin, 'exit_code': code, 'launch_error': error,
+                         'argv': identity['argv'], 'scope': 'Includes compilation; per-round serialization times are in the original probe stdout.'}
+              (out / 'execution.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
+              for name, stream in [('probe.stdout', sys.stdout.buffer), ('probe.stderr', sys.stderr.buffer)]:
+                  path = out / name
+                  if path.exists():
+                      with path.open('rb') as source:
+                          for block in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
+                              stream.write(block)
+                      stream.flush()
+          sys.exit(code)
+          PY
+      - name: Preserve after-source identity and original file hashes even on failure
+        if: always()
+        run: |
+          python3 -B - <<'PY'
+          import hashlib
+          import json
+          import os
+          from pathlib import Path
+          import re
+          import subprocess
+          import sys
+
+          def observe_cost_output(out, root, target):
+              records, binaries, finishes = [], [], []
+              execution = json.loads((out / 'execution.json').read_text())
+              assert execution['exit_code'] == 0 and execution['launch_error'] is None
+              raw = (out / 'probe.stdout').read_text()
+              for line in raw.splitlines():
+                  start = line.find('{')
+                  if start < 0:
+                      continue
+                  try:
+                      # libtest may prefix its first probe object with the test name.
+                      value, end = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(line[start:])
+                  except json.JSONDecodeError:
+                      continue
+                  if not isinstance(value, dict):
+                      continue
+                  if value.get('schema') == 'p8-oracle-serialization-equal-lifetime-cost-v1':
+                      assert not line[start + end:].strip(), 'trailing probe output'
+                      records.append(value)
+                  elif start == 0:
+                      if value.get('reason') == 'build-finished':
+                          finishes.append(value)
+                      if (value.get('reason') == 'compiler-artifact'
+                              and value.get('target', {}).get('name') == 'cc_eval'
+                              and value.get('target', {}).get('kind') == ['lib']
+                              and value.get('profile', {}).get('test') is True
+                              and value.get('executable')):
+                          binaries.append(value)
+              expected = {(case, round_) for case in
+                  ('multiple_text', 'short_fields', 'blob', 'empty_text', 'null') for round_ in range(20)}
+              slots = []
+              for value in records:
+                  assert type(value.get('round')) is int and type(value.get('rows')) is int
+                  assert value['rows'] == 256
+                  slots.append((value['case'], value['round']))
+                  assert value['first'] == ('original' if value['round'] % 2 == 0 else 'borrowed')
+                  assert all(isinstance(value.get(key), str) and re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]+', value[key])
+                             for key in ('original_ns', 'borrowed_ns'))
+                  assert re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{64}', value['original_digest'])
+                  assert value['original_digest'] == value['borrowed_digest']
+                  assert value['original_digest'] == value['reference_digest']
+                  assert type(value.get('canonical_bytes')) is int and value['canonical_bytes'] > 0
+                  assert value.get('timing_threshold', 'absent') is None
+                  assert value['original_row_projection_source_blob'] == '4c7fdb879e039af164b3b10ea1491d538c69ac68'
+                  assert value['timing_scope'] == ('same SQLite SELECT traversal plus row serialization and output retention; '
+                                                   'verification, hash and output drop excluded')
+                  assert value['output_lifetime'] == ('one immutable shared reference; each side output verified, '
+                                                     'hashed and dropped before next side timing')
+                  assert value['order_limit'] == 'alternating order retained; allocator and cache history not reset or claimed eliminated'
+                  assert value['comparison_protocol'] == ('independent equal-lifetime observation; '
+                                                         'not a rerun or correction of the v1 retained-pair probe')
+              assert len(slots) == 100 and len(set(slots)) == 100 and set(slots) == expected
+              assert re.search(r'test result: ok\. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;', raw)
+              assert finishes == [{'reason': 'build-finished', 'success': True}]
+              assert len(binaries) == 1
+              binary = binaries[0]
+              assert binary['package_id'].rpartition('#')[0].endswith('/cc-eval')
+              assert Path(binary['manifest_path']).resolve() == root / 'crates/cc-eval/Cargo.toml'
+              assert Path(binary['target']['src_path']).resolve() == root / 'crates/cc-eval/src/lib.rs'
+              assert binary['features'] == ['default'] and binary['fresh'] is False
+              assert binary['profile']['opt_level'] == '3' and binary['profile']['debug_assertions'] is False
+              executable = Path(binary['executable']).resolve(strict=True)
+              assert executable.is_file() and executable.is_relative_to(target.resolve())
+              digest = hashlib.sha256()
+              with executable.open('rb') as source:
+                  for block in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
+                      digest.update(block)
+              return {'schema': 'p8-oracle-serialization-equal-lifetime-cost-observation-v1', 'status': 'observed',
+                      'records': records, 'record_count': 100, 'compiler_artifact': binary,
+                      'test_executable_sha256': digest.hexdigest(), 'test_executable_bytes': executable.stat().st_size,
+                      'scope': 'Finite local mechanism cost only; no timing threshold or scale/TODO acceptance.'}
+
+          root = Path(os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE'])
+          out = Path(os.environ['P8_COST_OUTPUT'])
+          out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+          sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'scripts'))
+          receipt = {'source_unchanged': False, 'observer_inputs_unchanged': False,
+                     'toolchain_outputs_unchanged': False, 'error': None}
+          try:
+              from p7_build_identity import source_snapshot
+              after = source_snapshot(root)
+              (out / 'source-after.json').write_text(json.dumps(after, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
+              before = json.loads((out / 'source-before.json').read_text())
+              identity = json.loads((out / 'identity-before.json').read_text())
+              receipt['source_unchanged'] = after == before
+              receipt['observer_inputs_unchanged'] = all(
+                  hashlib.sha256((root / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest
+                  for path, digest in identity['observer_inputs'].items())
+              compiler = {}
+              for name, command in [('rustc', ['rustc', '-vV']), ('cargo', ['cargo', '-Vv'])]:
+                  value = subprocess.check_output(command, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
+                  (out / (name + '-after.txt')).write_bytes(value)
+                  compiler[name] = hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
+              receipt['toolchain_outputs_unchanged'] = compiler == identity['toolchain_output_sha256']
+              assert all(receipt[key] for key in ('source_unchanged', 'observer_inputs_unchanged', 'toolchain_outputs_unchanged'))
+              observed = observe_cost_output(out, root, Path(os.environ['CARGO_TARGET_DIR']))
+              (out / 'cost-observation.json').write_text(json.dumps(observed, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
+          except Exception as exc:
+              receipt['error'] = type(exc).__name__ + ': ' + str(exc)
+          finally:
+              receipt['files'] = {path.name: {'bytes': path.stat().st_size,
+                  'sha256': hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
+                  for path in sorted(out.iterdir()) if path.is_file() and path.name != 'identity-after.json'}
+              (out / 'identity-after.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
+          if receipt['error'] is not None:
+              raise SystemExit(1)
+          PY
+      - name: Preserve every original cost observation, including failure
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: p8-oracle-serialization-equal-lifetime-cost-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/p8-oracle-equal-lifetime-cost
+          if-no-files-found: error"},{"sha":"3810af972cf6cbe1a122e2c7ab8a92d1b8b38816","filename":"artifacts/checkpoints/p8-oracle-equal-lifetime-source-a217-20261009/actual-product-official-proof.json","status":"added","additions":96,"deletions":0,"changes":96,"blob_url":"https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/f6750cad0df45af4ec2dddc456e76cc188f3a35a/artifacts%2Fcheckpoints%2Fp8-oracle-equal-lifetime-source-a217-20261009%2Factual-product-official-proof.json","raw_url":"https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/raw/f6750cad0df45af4ec2dddc456e76cc188f3a35a/artifacts%2Fcheckpoints%2Fp8-oracle-equal-lifetime-source-a217-20261009%2Factual-product-official-proof.json","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/jyqj/codecortex/contents/artifacts%2Fcheckpoints%2Fp8-oracle-equal-lifetime-source-a217-20261009%2Factual-product-official-proof.json?ref=f6750cad0df45af4ec2dddc456e76cc188f3a35a","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,96 @@

+
+    #[test]
+    #[ignore = "explicit finite release cost observation; no timing acceptance threshold"]
+    fn borrowed_serialization_equal_lifetime_release_cost_probe() {
+        use rusqlite::types::Value as SqlValue;
+        use std::time::Instant;
+
+        fn collect(
+            statement: &mut rusqlite::Statement<'_>,
+            projection: &mut RowProjection<'_>,
+            borrowed: bool,
+        ) -> (Vec<String>, u128) {
+            let started = Instant::now();
+            let mut rows = statement.query([]).unwrap();
+            let mut output = Vec::new();
+            while let Some(row) = rows.next().unwrap() {
+                output.push(if borrowed {
+                    projection.serialize_row(row).unwrap()
+                } else {
+                    original_serialize_row(projection, row).unwrap()
+                });
+            }
+            (output, started.elapsed().as_nanos())
+        }
+
+        // The output Vec never crosses this function boundary. Both sides
+        // retain only the same immutable reference while their timer runs.
+        fn observe_side(
+            statement: &mut rusqlite::Statement<'_>,
+            projection: &mut RowProjection<'_>,
+            borrowed: bool,
+            reference: &[String],
+            reference_digest: &str,
+        ) -> (u128, String, usize) {
+            let (output, elapsed_ns) = collect(statement, projection, borrowed);
+            assert_eq!(output.as_slice(), reference);
+            assert_eq!(output.len(), 256);
+            let canonical_bytes = output.iter().map(String::len).sum();
+            let digest = manifest::digest(&serde_json::to_vec(&output).unwrap());
+            assert_eq!(digest, reference_digest);
+            drop(output);
+            (elapsed_ns, digest, canonical_bytes)
+        }
+
+        let cases = [
+            (
+                "multiple_text",
+                vec![
+                    SqlValue::Text("é/中文\n\"\\".repeat(512)),
+                    SqlValue::Text("manifest-payload".repeat(256)),
+                    SqlValue::Text("qualified::name".repeat(128)),
+                    SqlValue::Text("path/to/source.rs".repeat(128)),
+                    SqlValue::Integer(17),
+                    SqlValue::Null,
+                ],
+            ),
+            (
+                "short_fields",
+                vec![
+                    SqlValue::Text("a".into()),
+                    SqlValue::Text("bc".into()),
+                    SqlValue::Integer(i64::MIN),
+                    SqlValue::Integer(i64::MAX),
+                    SqlValue::Real(-0.0),
+                    SqlValue::Real(1.25),
+                ],
+            ),
+            (
+                "blob",
+                vec![
+                    SqlValue::Blob([0, 255, 128, 1].repeat(1024)),
+                    SqlValue::Blob(Vec::new()),
+                    SqlValue::Text("blob-name".into()),
+                    SqlValue::Integer(4),
+                    SqlValue::Null,
+                    SqlValue::Real(0.0),
+                ],
+            ),
+            ("empty_text", vec![SqlValue::Text(String::new()); 6]),
+            ("null", vec![SqlValue::Null; 6]),
+        ];
+        let cols: Vec<String> = ["z", "a", "payload", "path", "ordinal", "empty"]
+            .into_iter()
+            .map(String::from)
+            .collect();
+        for (case, values) in cases {
+            let conn = Connection::open_in_memory().unwrap();
+            conn.execute_batch("CREATE TABLE sample(c0,c1,c2,c3,c4,c5)")
+                .unwrap();
+            for _ in 0..256 {
+                conn.execute(
+                    "INSERT INTO sample VALUES(?1,?2,?3,?4,?5,?6)",
+                    rusqlite::params_from_iter(&values),
+                )
+                .unwrap();
+            }
+            let mut statement = conn
+                .prepare("SELECT c0,c1,c2,c3,c4,c5 FROM sample ORDER BY rowid")
+                .unwrap();
+            let mut original = RowProjection::new(&cols);
+            let mut borrowed = RowProjection::new(&cols);
+            // Independent protocol: build one immutable complete reference
+            // outside all measured rounds. Preserve the original baseline's
+            // reusable Map and the same SQLite input/SELECT for both sides.
+            let (reference, _) = collect(&mut statement, &mut original, false);
+            assert_eq!(reference.len(), 256);
+            let reference_digest = manifest::digest(&serde_json::to_vec(&reference).unwrap());
+            let reference_bytes = reference.iter().map(String::len).sum::<usize>();
+            for is_borrowed in [false, true] {
+                let projection = if is_borrowed {
+                    &mut borrowed
+                } else {
+                    &mut original
+                };
+                let _ = observe_side(
+                    &mut statement,
+                    projection,
+                    is_borrowed,
+                    &reference,
+                    &reference_digest,
+                );
+            }
+            for round in 0..20 {
+                // Each completed side verifies full bytes, hashes and drops
+                // its output before the next side enters collect's timer.
+                let (original_result, borrowed_result) = if round % 2 == 0 {
+                    let original_result = observe_side(
+                        &mut statement,
+                        &mut original,
+                        false,
+                        &reference,
+                        &reference_digest,
+                    );
+                    let borrowed_result = observe_side(
+                        &mut statement,
+                        &mut borrowed,
+                        true,
+                        &reference,
+                        &reference_digest,
+                    );
+                    (original_result, borrowed_result)
+                } else {
+                    let borrowed_result = observe_side(
+                        &mut statement,
+                        &mut borrowed,
+                        true,
+                        &reference,
+                        &reference_digest,
+                    );
+                    let original_result = observe_side(
+                        &mut statement,
+                        &mut original,
+                        false,
+                        &reference,
+                        &reference_digest,
+                    );
+                    (original_result, borrowed_result)
+                };
+                let (original_ns, original_digest, original_bytes) = original_result;
+                let (borrowed_ns, borrowed_digest, borrowed_bytes) = borrowed_result;
+                assert_eq!(original_bytes, reference_bytes);
+                assert_eq!(borrowed_bytes, reference_bytes);
+                println!(
+                    "{}",
+                    json!({
+                        "schema": "p8-oracle-serialization-equal-lifetime-cost-v1",
+                        "case": case,
+                        "round": round,
+                        "first": if round % 2 == 0 { "original" } else { "borrowed" },
+                        "rows": reference.len(),
+                        "canonical_bytes": reference_bytes,
+                        "original_ns": original_ns.to_string(),
+                        "borrowed_ns": borrowed_ns.to_string(),
+                        "reference_digest": reference_digest,
+                        "original_digest": original_digest,
+                        "borrowed_digest": borrowed_digest,
+                        "timing_scope": "same SQLite SELECT traversal plus row serialization and output retention; verification, hash and output drop excluded",
+                        "output_lifetime": "one immutable shared reference; each side output verified, hashed and dropped before next side timing",
+                        "order_limit": "alternating order retained; allocator and cache history not reset or claimed eliminated",
+                        "timing_threshold": null,
+                        "original_row_projection_source_blob": "4c7fdb879e039af164b3b10ea1491d538c69ac68",
+                        "comparison_protocol": "independent equal-lifetime observation; not a rerun or correction of the v1 retained-pair probe"
+                    })
+                );
+            }
+        }
+    }

name: P8 oracle equal-lifetime serialization cost observation

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    types: [labeled]

permissions:
  contents: read

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: never
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: '0'
  CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: '2'
  RUSTFLAGS: ''
  CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS: ''
  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
  P8_COST_EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
  P8_COST_TEST: benchmark::oracle::projection_tests::borrowed_serialization_equal_lifetime_release_cost_probe

jobs:
  observe:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.label.name == 'p8-oracle-equal-lifetime-cost-run'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /*
            !/artifacts/
      - name: Prepare original output directory
        run: |
          mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/p8-oracle-equal-lifetime-cost"
          printf 'P8_COST_OUTPUT=%s/p8-oracle-equal-lifetime-cost\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR=%s/p8-oracle-equal-lifetime-cost-target\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.95.0
      - name: Bind actual source, compiler and probe command
        run: |
          python3 -B - <<'PY'
          import hashlib
          import json
          import os
          from pathlib import Path
          import subprocess
          import sys
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          root = Path(os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE'])
          out = Path(os.environ['P8_COST_OUTPUT'])
          sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'scripts'))
          from p7_build_identity import source_snapshot

          source = source_snapshot(root)
          assert source['source_commit'] == os.environ['P8_COST_EXPECTED_HEAD']
          observers = {}
          for path in ('scripts/p7_build_identity.py', '.github/workflows/p8-oracle-serialization-equal-lifetime-cost.yml'):
              original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + path], cwd=root)
              live = (root / path).read_bytes()
              assert live == original, path
              observers[path] = hashlib.sha256(live).hexdigest()
          (out / 'source-before.json').write_text(json.dumps(source, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
          (out / 'Cargo.lock').write_bytes((root / 'Cargo.lock').read_bytes())
          compiler = {}
          for name, command in [('rustc', ['rustc', '-vV']), ('cargo', ['cargo', '-Vv'])]:
              value = subprocess.check_output(command, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
              (out / (name + '-before.txt')).write_bytes(value)
              compiler[name] = hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
          argv = ['cargo', 'test', '--release', '--locked', '--message-format=json', '-p', 'cc-eval', '--lib',
                  os.environ['P8_COST_TEST'], '--', '--exact', '--ignored', '--nocapture', '--test-threads=1']
          receipt = {'schema': 'p8-oracle-serialization-equal-lifetime-cost-observation-v1',
                     'created_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                     'run_id': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'], 'run_attempt': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT'],
                     'expected_source': os.environ['P8_COST_EXPECTED_HEAD'],
                     'source_commit': source['source_commit'], 'source_tree': source['source_tree'],
                     'Cargo_lock_sha256': hashlib.sha256((root / 'Cargo.lock').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                     'observer_inputs': observers, 'toolchain_output_sha256': compiler, 'argv': argv,
                     'environment': {key: os.environ.get(key) for key in
                         ('CARGO_INCREMENTAL', 'CARGO_BUILD_JOBS', 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR', 'RUSTFLAGS',
                          'CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS', 'RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN', 'TMPDIR', 'TMP', 'TEMP')},
                     'scope': 'Finite release serialization cost observation; not a scale sample or TODO acceptance gate.'}
          (out / 'identity-before.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
          PY
      - name: Observe the independent equal-lifetime finite ignored probe and retain both streams
        run: |
          python3 -B - <<'PY'
          import json
          import os
          from pathlib import Path
          import subprocess
          import sys
          import time
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          out = Path(os.environ['P8_COST_OUTPUT'])
          identity = json.loads((out / 'identity-before.json').read_text())
          started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
          begin = time.monotonic_ns()
          code = None
          error = None
          try:
              with (out / 'probe.stdout').open('wb') as stdout, (out / 'probe.stderr').open('wb') as stderr:
                  code = subprocess.run(identity['argv'], cwd=os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE'],
                                        stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, check=False).returncode
          except BaseException as exc:
              error = type(exc).__name__ + ': ' + str(exc)
              raise
          finally:
              receipt = {'started_utc': started, 'finished_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                         'wall_ns': time.monotonic_ns() - begin, 'exit_code': code, 'launch_error': error,
                         'argv': identity['argv'], 'scope': 'Includes compilation; per-round serialization times are in the original probe stdout.'}
              (out / 'execution.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
              for name, stream in [('probe.stdout', sys.stdout.buffer), ('probe.stderr', sys.stderr.buffer)]:
                  path = out / name
                  if path.exists():
                      with path.open('rb') as source:
                          for block in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
                              stream.write(block)
                      stream.flush()
          sys.exit(code)
          PY
      - name: Preserve after-source identity and original file hashes even on failure
        if: always()
        run: |
          python3 -B - <<'PY'
          import hashlib
          import json
          import os
          from pathlib import Path
          import re
          import subprocess
          import sys

          def observe_cost_output(out, root, target):
              records, binaries, finishes = [], [], []
              execution = json.loads((out / 'execution.json').read_text())
              assert execution['exit_code'] == 0 and execution['launch_error'] is None
              raw = (out / 'probe.stdout').read_text()
              for line in raw.splitlines():
                  start = line.find('{')
                  if start < 0:
                      continue
                  try:
                      # libtest may prefix its first probe object with the test name.
                      value, end = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(line[start:])
                  except json.JSONDecodeError:
                      continue
                  if not isinstance(value, dict):
                      continue
                  if value.get('schema') == 'p8-oracle-serialization-equal-lifetime-cost-v1':
                      assert not line[start + end:].strip(), 'trailing probe output'
                      records.append(value)
                  elif start == 0:
                      if value.get('reason') == 'build-finished':
                          finishes.append(value)
                      if (value.get('reason') == 'compiler-artifact'
                              and value.get('target', {}).get('name') == 'cc_eval'
                              and value.get('target', {}).get('kind') == ['lib']
                              and value.get('profile', {}).get('test') is True
                              and value.get('executable')):
                          binaries.append(value)
              expected = {(case, round_) for case in
                  ('multiple_text', 'short_fields', 'blob', 'empty_text', 'null') for round_ in range(20)}
              slots = []
              for value in records:
                  assert type(value.get('round')) is int and type(value.get('rows')) is int
                  assert value['rows'] == 256
                  slots.append((value['case'], value['round']))
                  assert value['first'] == ('original' if value['round'] % 2 == 0 else 'borrowed')
                  assert all(isinstance(value.get(key), str) and re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]+', value[key])
                             for key in ('original_ns', 'borrowed_ns'))
                  assert re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{64}', value['original_digest'])
                  assert value['original_digest'] == value['borrowed_digest']
                  assert value['original_digest'] == value['reference_digest']
                  assert type(value.get('canonical_bytes')) is int and value['canonical_bytes'] > 0
                  assert value.get('timing_threshold', 'absent') is None

structuredContent.content:
name: P8 oracle equal-lifetime serialization cost observation

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    types: [labeled]

permissions:
  contents: read

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: never
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: '0'
  CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: '2'
  RUSTFLAGS: ''
  CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS: ''
  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
  P8_COST_EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
  P8_COST_TEST: benchmark::oracle::projection_tests::borrowed_serialization_equal_lifetime_release_cost_probe

jobs:
  observe:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.label.name == 'p8-oracle-equal-lifetime-cost-run'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /*
            !/artifacts/
      - name: Prepare original output directory
        run: |
          mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/p8-oracle-equal-lifetime-cost"
          printf 'P8_COST_OUTPUT=%s/p8-oracle-equal-lifetime-cost\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR=%s/p8-oracle-equal-lifetime-cost-target\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.95.0
      - name: Bind actual source, compiler and probe command
        run: |
          python3 -B - <<'PY'
          import hashlib
          import json
          import os
          from pathlib import Path
          import subprocess
          import sys
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          root = Path(os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE'])
          out = Path(os.environ['P8_COST_OUTPUT'])
          sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'scripts'))
          from p7_build_identity import source_snapshot

          source = source_snapshot(root)
          assert source['source_commit'] == os.environ['P8_COST_EXPECTED_HEAD']
          observers = {}
          for path in ('scripts/p7_build_identity.py', '.github/workflows/p8-oracle-serialization-equal-lifetime-cost.yml'):
              original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + path], cwd=root)
              live = (root / path).read_bytes()
              assert live == original, path
              observers[path] = hashlib.sha256(live).hexdigest()
          (out / 'source-before.json').write_text(json.dumps(source, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
          (out / 'Cargo.lock').write_bytes((root / 'Cargo.lock').read_bytes())
          compiler = {}
          for name, command in [('rustc', ['rustc', '-vV']), ('cargo', ['cargo', '-Vv'])]:
              value = subprocess.check_output(command, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
              (out / (name + '-before.txt')).write_bytes(value)
              compiler[name] = hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
          argv = ['cargo', 'test', '--release', '--locked', '--message-format=json', '-p', 'cc-eval', '--lib',
                  os.environ['P8_COST_TEST'], '--', '--exact', '--ignored', '--nocapture', '--test-threads=1']
          receipt = {'schema': 'p8-oracle-serialization-equal-lifetime-cost-observation-v1',
                     'created_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                     'run_id': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'], 'run_attempt': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT'],
                     'expected_source': os.environ['P8_COST_EXPECTED_HEAD'],
                     'source_commit': source['source_commit'], 'source_tree': source['source_tree'],
                     'Cargo_lock_sha256': hashlib.sha256((root / 'Cargo.lock').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                     'observer_inputs': observers, 'toolchain_output_sha256': compiler, 'argv': argv,
                     'environment': {key: os.environ.get(key) for key in
                         ('CARGO_INCREMENTAL', 'CARGO_BUILD_JOBS', 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR', 'RUSTFLAGS',
                          'CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS', 'RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN', 'TMPDIR', 'TMP', 'TEMP')},
                     'scope': 'Finite release serialization cost observation; not a scale sample or TODO acceptance gate.'}
          (out / 'identity-before.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
          PY
      - name: Observe the independent equal-lifetime finite ignored probe and retain both streams
        run: |
          python3 -B - <<'PY'
          import json
          import os
          from pathlib import Path
          import subprocess
          import sys
          import time
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          out = Path(os.environ['P8_COST_OUTPUT'])
          identity = json.loads((out / 'identity-before.json').read_text())
          started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
          begin = time.monotonic_ns()
          code = None
          error = None
          try:
              with (out / 'probe.stdout').open('wb') as stdout, (out / 'probe.stderr').open('wb') as stderr:
                  code = subprocess.run(identity['argv'], cwd=os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE'],
                                        stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, check=False).returncode
          except BaseException as exc:
              error = type(exc).__name__ + ': ' + str(exc)
              raise
          finally:
              receipt = {'started_utc': started, 'finished_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                         'wall_ns': time.monotonic_ns() - begin, 'exit_code': code, 'launch_error': error,
                         'argv': identity['argv'], 'scope': 'Includes compilation; per-round serialization times are in the original probe stdout.'}
              (out / 'execution.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
              for name, stream in [('probe.stdout', sys.stdout.buffer), ('probe.stderr', sys.stderr.buffer)]:
                  path = out / name
                  if path.exists():
                      with path.open('rb') as source:
                          for block in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
                              stream.write(block)
                      stream.flush()
          sys.exit(code)
          PY
      - name: Preserve after-source identity and original file hashes even on failure
        if: always()
        run: |
          python3 -B - <<'PY'
          import hashlib
          import json
          import os
          from pathlib import Path
          import re
          import subprocess
          import sys

          def observe_cost_output(out, root, target):
              records, binaries, finishes = [], [], []
              execution = json.loads((out / 'execution.json').read_text())
              assert execution['exit_code'] == 0 and execution['launch_error'] is None
              raw = (out / 'probe.stdout').read_text()
              for line in raw.splitlines():
                  start = line.find('{')
                  if start < 0:
                      continue
                  try:
                      # libtest may prefix its first probe object with the test name.
                      value, end = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(line[start:])
                  except json.JSONDecodeError:
                      continue
                  if not isinstance(value, dict):
                      continue
                  if value.get('schema') == 'p8-oracle-serialization-equal-lifetime-cost-v1':
                      assert not line[start + end:].strip(), 'trailing probe output'
                      records.append(value)
                  elif start == 0:
                      if value.get('reason') == 'build-finished':
                          finishes.append(value)
                      if (value.get('reason') == 'compiler-artifact'
                              and value.get('target', {}).get('name') == 'cc_eval'
                              and value.get('target', {}).get('kind') == ['lib']
                              and value.get('profile', {}).get('test') is True
                              and value.get('executable')):
                          binaries.append(value)
              expected = {(case, round_) for case in
                  ('multiple_text', 'short_fields', 'blob', 'empty_text', 'null') for round_ in range(20)}
              slots = []
              for value in records:
                  assert type(value.get('round')) is int and type(value.get('rows')) is int
                  assert value['rows'] == 256
                  slots.append((value['case'], value['round']))
                  assert value['first'] == ('original' if value['round'] % 2 == 0 else 'borrowed')
                  assert all(isinstance(value.get(key), str) and re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]+', value[key])
                             for key in ('original_ns', 'borrowed_ns'))
                  assert re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{64}', value['original_digest'])
                  assert value['original_digest'] == value['borrowed_digest']
                  assert value['original_digest'] == value['reference_digest']
                  assert type(value.get('canonical_bytes')) is int and value['canonical_bytes'] > 0
                  assert value.get('timing_threshold', 'absent') is None
                  assert value['original_row_projection_source_blob'] == '4c7fdb879e039af164b3b10ea1491d538c69ac68'
                  assert value['timing_scope'] == ('same SQLite SELECT traversal plus row serialization and output retention; '
                                                   'verification, hash and output drop excluded')
                  assert value['output_lifetime'] == ('one immutable shared reference; each side output verified, '
                                                     'hashed and dropped before next side timing')
                  assert value['order_limit'] == 'alternating order retained; allocator and cache history not reset or claimed eliminated'
                  assert value['comparison_protocol'] == ('independent equal-lifetime observation; '
                                                         'not a rerun or correction of the v1 retained-pair probe')
              assert len(slots) == 100 and len(set(slots)) == 100 and set(slots) == expected
              assert re.search(r'test result: ok\. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;', raw)
              assert finishes == [{'reason': 'build-finished', 'success': True}]
              assert len(binaries) == 1
              binary = binaries[0]
              assert binary['package_id'].rpartition('#')[0].endswith('/cc-eval')
              assert Path(binary['manifest_path']).resolve() == root / 'crates/cc-eval/Cargo.toml'
              assert Path(binary['target']['src_path']).resolve() == root / 'crates/cc-eval/src/lib.rs'
              assert binary['features'] == ['default'] and binary['fresh'] is False
              assert binary['profile']['opt_level'] == '3' and binary['profile']['debug_assertions'] is False
              executable = Path(binary['executable']).resolve(strict=True)
              assert executable.is_file() and executable.is_relative_to(target.resolve())
              digest = hashlib.sha256()
              with executable.open('rb') as source:
                  for block in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
                      digest.update(block)
              return {'schema': 'p8-oracle-serialization-equal-lifetime-cost-observation-v1', 'status': 'observed',
                      'records': records, 'record_count': 100, 'compiler_artifact': binary,
                      'test_executable_sha256': digest.hexdigest(), 'test_executable_bytes': executable.stat().st_size,
                      'scope': 'Finite local mechanism cost only; no timing threshold or scale/TODO acceptance.'}

          root = Path(os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE'])
          out = Path(os.environ['P8_COST_OUTPUT'])
          out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
          sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'scripts'))
          receipt = {'source_unchanged': False, 'observer_inputs_unchanged': False,
                     'toolchain_outputs_unchanged': False, 'error': None}
          try:
              from p7_build_identity import source_snapshot
              after = source_snapshot(root)
              (out / 'source-after.json').write_text(json.dumps(after, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
              before = json.loads((out / 'source-before.json').read_text())
              identity = json.loads((out / 'identity-before.json').read_text())
              receipt['source_unchanged'] = after == before
              receipt['observer_inputs_unchanged'] = all(
                  hashlib.sha256((root / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest
                  for path, digest in identity['observer_inputs'].items())
              compiler = {}
              for name, command in [('rustc', ['rustc', '-vV']), ('cargo', ['cargo', '-Vv'])]:
                  value = subprocess.check_output(command, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
                  (out / (name + '-after.txt')).write_bytes(value)
                  compiler[name] = hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
              receipt['toolchain_outputs_unchanged'] = compiler == identity['toolchain_output_sha256']
              assert all(receipt[key] for key in ('source_unchanged', 'observer_inputs_unchanged', 'toolchain_outputs_unchanged'))
              observed = observe_cost_output(out, root, Path(os.environ['CARGO_TARGET_DIR']))
              (out / 'cost-observation.json').write_text(json.dumps(observed, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
          except Exception as exc:
              receipt['error'] = type(exc).__name__ + ': ' + str(exc)
          finally:
              receipt['files'] = {path.name: {'bytes': path.stat().st_size,
                  'sha256': hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
                  for path in sorted(out.iterdir()) if path.is_file() and path.name != 'identity-after.json'}
              (out / 'identity-after.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
          if receipt['error'] is not None:
              raise SystemExit(1)
          PY
      - name: Preserve every original cost observation, including failure
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: p8-oracle-serialization-equal-lifetime-cost-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/p8-oracle-equal-lifetime-cost
          if-no-files-found: error

Borrow SQLite row text during exact canonical JSON projection to remove temporary owned text copies. Preserve the original field ordering, duplicate-column result, real-number encoding, escaped-byte budgets and error order.

This remains a Draft against the fixed review base `fffd950d5b34b0180f308db1428a57d5bf358bf1`. Current head is **`9ddae045f6925140a4d652c5f28f64add459eff1`**, a formatter-only successor of the original cost-study source.

## Actual correctness verification

All three jobs in [ordinary CI run 37961137036](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37961137036) passed; the [main check](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37961137036/job/113923960385) finished at **2026-10-09 17:48:54 UTC**. Its complete original log and independent review are retained. The actual PR test-merge tree exactly equals the reviewed head tree `20ae2605cad47e1b56c80e5f83278bbd34744982`.

Formatting, Clippy, all-target compilation, authorized regressions and the original source/task guards passed. Each of the four new controls actually passed in both default and eval-http executions:

- Reordered and duplicate columns produce the original bytes.
- Escaped byte lengths preserve row-boundary budgets.
- SELECT errors retain their order and subsequent recovery behavior.
- Real values retain the original Value encoding.

The finite ignored cost probe remained ignored in these ordinary regression executions.

## Cost observations and adoption decision

**Default adoption remains on hold.** The original cost study is [run 37956976406](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37956976406), source **`eded24951c3e99693410ce959a627ab575f66bec`**. It retains all **100 measurements: five cases × 20 alternating-order pairs**, with complete byte assertions. No observations were trimmed.

The four smaller/blob cases were faster in all 20 pairs. The `multiple_text` case had median paired borrowed/original ratio **1.0664289** and was faster in only 10/20 pairs. Ordering matters: its medians were 1.2050854 with original-first and 0.9557795 with borrowed-first. The first side's result vector also remained live while the second side was timed. These observations do not establish an end-to-end parity or indexing improvement.

A separately prepared equal-lifetime candidate remains an untriggered, archived alternative. Its code and prospective measurements are not credited to this PR or the original study.

## Preserved evidence and scope

The [original ZIP custody branch](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/evidence/p8-originals-oracle-eded-a217-20261009) preserves the complete original artifact, job log, restoration hashes and all cost records. The original formatter failure, its later repair and the correction of an unsupported metadata capture timestamp remain explicit history.

[The current public source-admission archive](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/e5d381667d19922b006f45075fc077f8a73197c3/artifacts/checkpoints) contains the prior fixed reviews and execution receipts; the newly completed ordinary CI log is being appended separately.

Borrow SQLite row text during exact canonical JSON projection to remove temporary owned text copies. Preserve the original field ordering, duplicate-column result, real-number encoding, escaped-byte budgets and error order.

This remains a Draft against the fixed review base `fffd950d5b34b0180f308db1428a57d5bf358bf1`. Current head is **`9ddae045f6925140a4d652c5f28f64add459eff1`**, a formatter-only successor of the original cost-study source.

## Actual correctness verification

All three jobs in [ordinary CI run 37961137036](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37961137036) passed; the [main check](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37961137036/job/113923960385) finished at **2026-10-09 17:48:54 UTC**. Its complete original log and independent review are retained. The actual PR test-merge tree exactly equals the reviewed head tree `20ae2605cad47e1b56c80e5f83278bbd34744982`.

Formatting, Clippy, all-target compilation, authorized regressions and the original source/task guards passed. Each of the four new controls actually passed in both default and eval-http executions:

- Reordered and duplicate columns produce the original bytes.
- Escaped byte lengths preserve row-boundary budgets.
- SELECT errors retain their order and subsequent recovery behavior.
- Real values retain the original Value encoding.

The finite ignored cost probe remained ignored in these ordinary regression executions.

## Cost observations and adoption decision

**Default adoption remains on hold.** The original cost study is [run 37956976406](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37956976406), source **`eded24951c3e99693410ce959a627ab575f66bec`**. It retains all **100 measurements: five cases × 20 alternating-order pairs**, with complete byte assertions. No observations were trimmed.

The four smaller/blob cases were faster in all 20 pairs. The `multiple_text` case had median paired borrowed/original ratio **1.0664289** and was faster in only 10/20 pairs. Ordering matters: its medians were 1.2050854 with original-first and 0.9557795 with borrowed-first. The first side's result vector also remained live while the second side was timed. These observations do not establish an end-to-end parity or indexing improvement.

A separately prepared equal-lifetime candidate remains an untriggered, archived alternative. Its code and prospective measurements are not credited to this PR or the original study.

## Preserved evidence and scope

The [original ZIP custody branch](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/evidence/p8-originals-oracle-eded-a217-20261009) preserves the complete original artifact, job log, restoration hashes and all cost records. The original formatter failure, its later repair and the correction of an unsupported metadata capture timestamp remain explicit history.

## Purpose and behavior

Borrow SQLite row text during exact canonical JSON projection to remove temporary owned text copies. Preserve the original field ordering, duplicate-column result, real-number encoding, escaped-byte budgets and error order.

This remains a Draft against the fixed review base `fffd950d5b34b0180f308db1428a57d5bf358bf1`. Current head is **`9ddae045f6925140a4d652c5f28f64add459eff1`**, a formatter-only successor of the original cost-study source.

## Actual correctness verification

All three jobs in [ordinary CI run 37961137036](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37961137036) passed; the [main check](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37961137036/job/113923960385) finished at **2026-10-09 17:48:54 UTC**. Its complete original log and independent review are retained. The actual PR test-merge tree exactly equals the reviewed head tree `20ae2605cad47e1b56c80e5f83278bbd34744982`.

Formatting, Clippy, all-target compilation, authorized regressions and the original source/task guards passed. Each of the four new controls actually passed in both default and eval-http executions:

- Reordered and duplicate columns produce the original bytes.
- Escaped byte lengths preserve row-boundary budgets.
- SELECT errors retain their order and subsequent recovery behavior.
- Real values retain the original Value encoding.

The finite ignored cost probe remained ignored in these ordinary regression executions.

## Cost observations and adoption decision

**Default adoption remains on hold.** The original cost study is [run 37956976406](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37956976406), source **`eded24951c3e99693410ce959a627ab575f66bec`**. It retains all **100 measurements: five cases × 20 alternating-order pairs**, with complete byte assertions. No observations were trimmed.

The four smaller/blob cases were faster in all 20 pairs. The `multiple_text` case had median paired borrowed/original ratio **1.0664289** and was faster in only 10/20 pairs. Ordering matters: its medians were 1.2050854 with original-first and 0.9557795 with borrowed-first. The first side's result vector also remained live while the second side was timed. These observations do not establish an end-to-end parity or indexing improvement.

A separately prepared equal-lifetime candidate remains an untriggered, archived alternative. Its code and prospective measurements are not credited to this PR or the original study.

## Preserved evidence and scope

The [original ZIP custody branch](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/evidence/p8-originals-oracle-eded-a217-20261009) preserves the complete original artifact, job log, restoration hashes and all cost records. The original formatter failure, its later repair and the correction of an unsupported metadata capture timestamp remain explicit history.

[The current public source-admission archive](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/e5d381667d19922b006f45075fc077f8a73197c3/artifacts/checkpoints) contains the prior fixed reviews and execution receipts; the newly completed ordinary CI log is being appended separately.

No full 150/1500 matrix, workload speedup, release approval or original TODO completion is claimed here. Original task ledger remains **192 total / 163 done / 29 remaining / 0 newly completed**.
